guideMeta.label: Steps to connect a Meta account

app.title: Create a Meta app and add WhatsApp to it
app.hint: Meta also creates a test account and a test number, which can be used here.

number.title: Add your number in WhatsApp Manager
number.hint: Optional to start with the test number.

guideMeta.dedicatedText: A number used in the WhatsApp Business app must first be deleted there: its account in the app and its conversation history are lost. Keeping that number both in the app and on the API (coexistence) will only be possible with Meta Connect, coming later.

token.title: Create a system user and generate a non-expiring token
token.hint: In your Meta Business portfolio settings, then System users, add a system user, give it access to the app and to the WhatsApp Business account, then generate a token with the whatsapp_business_management and whatsapp_business_messaging permissions. The app secret is in your Meta app's basic settings.

guideCm.label: Steps to connect a CM.com account

account.title: Find the CM.com account ID
account.hint: The accountId is an identifier (GUID) of your account, shown in the CM.com platform.

token.title: Find the productToken
token.hint: The productToken is in the CM.com Channels application, under the "API Access and Settings" menu then "Authentication". It may also have been given to you by your CM.com contact. It gives access to your messages: do not share it.
